[SWS_CM_11402] Service skeleton FieldType class
⌈
Each skeleton Field
class (according to [SWS_CM_00007]) shall provide a type alias named FieldType
for the CppImplementationDataType of the Field (i.e., for the CppImplementa-
tionDataType which is either referenced by the VariableDataPrototype in role
type or via indirection of a DataTypeMap).
1
using FieldType = <name>;
where <name> is the Cpp Implementation Data Type symbol of the CppImplementa-
tionDataType of the Field.
⌋
